notes: Request-side: the spec's "SSE Stream Format" example request (stream_format "sse") plus instructions. Neither is forwarded, so OpenAI answers raw audio (the default); response.bin is that answer. Recordable.

sanity_gaps.reason: known gap O21: models.SpeechRequest has no field for it and no Extra, so instructions (voice steering for gpt-4o-mini-tts) and stream_format "sse" (speech.audio.delta / speech.audio.done events, the only TTS response that reports token usage) never reach OpenAI
